Is Aditya Birla Health Insurance good for claims? Do they actually settle claims or reject them? How much money do they really pay? In this video, we break down Aditya Birla Health Insurance's complete claims performance using IRDAI public disclosure data up to March 2026.

📊 REPORT CARD SUMMARY — KEY FINDINGS:
▶ Claim Settlement Ratio (CSR): 97.26% — Excellent ✅
Out of 29,88,248 total claims, 29,06,259 were settled. That means 97 out of every 100 health insurance claims got settled. One of the best in the industry.

▶ Claims Paid Ratio (CPR): 83.87% — Good 👍
₹4,199.94 Cr was claimed, ₹3,522.53 Cr was actually paid. Company is paying about 84 paise for every ₹1 claimed. Not bad, but there is some deduction happening — something policyholders should be aware of.

▶ Incurred Claims Ratio (ICR): 78.60% — Ideal Zone ✅
For every ₹100 of premium collected, Aditya Birla is paying back ₹78.60 in claims. This falls right in the sweet spot of 70-85%, which means the company is neither being too restrictive nor financially stressed.

▶ Complaints Per 10,000 Claims: 17.66 — Good 👍
5,027 claim-related complaints were filed against 28,46,356 total claims. Out of these, 1,050 were fully accepted by the company — meaning these should have been resolved proactively without the customer having to complain.

▶ Claims Settlement Speed: 98.82% within 1 month — Excellent ✅
28,72,086 out of 29,06,259 claims were settled within 30 days. Only 11 claims took more than a year. This is outstanding speed.
🏆 OVERALL GRADE: A (Very Good) — 88.75 / 100
Weighted Score Breakdown:

Claim Settlement Ratio (25% weight) → Score: 100
Claims Paid Ratio (25% weight) → Score: 75
Complaints Index (20% weight) → Score: 75
Settlement Speed (15% weight) → Score: 100
Incurred Claims Ratio (15% weight) → Score: 100

❓ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
Q: Is Aditya Birla Health Insurance good?
A: Based on claims data, yes — 97.26% CSR and 98.82% claims settled within 1 month. Grade A with 88.75/100 score.

Q: Does Aditya Birla Health Insurance reject claims?
A: Only about 2.74% claims were not settled. 81,989 claims were repudiated out of 29,88,248 total.

Q: How fast does Aditya Birla settle health insurance claims?
A: 98.82% of all claims are settled within 1 month. Extremely fast.

Q: Is Aditya Birla better than Star Health or HDFC ERGO?
